name: structured-artifact-viewer
description: Bounded inspection for unknown-size, large, generated, or high-output structured artifacts.

interface.longDescription: Provides a single low-context MCP tool, compact local CLI, and skill guidance for bounded inspection of unknown-size, large, generated, or high-output JSON, JSONL, CSV, TSV, Parquet metadata, and tool artifact files. It summarizes shape and previews selected fields without replacing jq or direct reads of small known config files.
